title: WPMS/762/2003 of BHUDEW SINGH Vs D.M. and ORS.

paras.text:
Writ Petition no. 762 (M/S) of 2003
Bhudev Singh---- Petitioner
Versus
District Magistrate, Udham Singh Nagar
and another Respondents
Hon'ble M.M. Ghildiyal J.
 Heard Sri Khalil Ahmad learned counsel for the petitioner,
learned Standing Counsel for respondent no.1 and Sri K.K.Sah learned
counsel for the respondent no.2.
 The petitioner has challenged the citation issued by the respondents
for recovery of loan of Rs.1,36,915.00. The petitioner has made a request
that he is ready to pay the amount but due to financial condition he is not in
a position to pay the same and accordingly the petitioner may be permitted
to deposit the amount in four equal installments. Sri K.K.Sah learned
counsel appearing on behalf of respondent no.2 has no objection to it.
The implementation of citation shall remain stayed provided the
petitioner deposits 1/4th of the amount of citation within a period of four
months and continues to deposit the remaining amount in three equal
installments after interval of two months each.
With these observations the writ petition is disposed of finally.
August 21, 2003 (M.M. Ghildiyal, J.)
MPS
